messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected on inference-gateway across us-west-2. Metric: inference_gateway.p99_tokens=1200ms, streaming_tail_errors=42
Ana (oncall): seeing it too, paging Mike and Jess. Reassigning
Mike (infra): on my way, pulling gateway logs. Any customer reports?
Ana (oncall): nothing from CS yet, but p95 up ~400ms, p99 > 1s. Streaming stalls in live sessions.
Jess (sre): checking control-plane (auth/config/featureflag) traces. Saw spike in /config/fetch latency to pg-store.
Tom (prod-eng): are we hitting auth token DB? I see repeated 429s from token-store for inference-gateway
Mike (infra): confirmed token-store p99 ~900ms, errors upstream. Rate limiter rejects spiking.
Ana (oncall): immediate mitigation: enable gateway fallback to cached-config variant and route non-critical traffic to dedicated fallback pool. I'll flip the rollout flag.
Jess (sre): rolling back recent feature-flag rollout now: `rwr feature-flag/fastcache --rollback --reason "latency spike"`
deploy-bot: deploy start: rollback feature-flag/fastcache by Jess at commit abc123
Tom (prod-eng): adding temporary rate-limit exception for dedicated-inference role: `curl -X POST https://admin.internal/ratelimit/adjust -d '{"role":"dedicated-inference","limit":4000}'`
Mike (infra): increased limit, but we still have DB contention. Let's enable read-replica for token reads. Starting replica promotion.
Jess (sre): enabling prefix KV caching on gateway (30s TTL) to cut config fetches. `CFG_PREFIX_CACHE_TTL=30`
Ana (oncall): notifying CS to pre-empt customers: @customer-success can you ping top customers about potential degradations? Use template: "We observed increased latency..."
customer-success: noted, we'll outbound small group and monitor.
Tom (prod-eng): temporary routing rule added: route: inference-gateway -> fallback-pool for streaming sessions older than 10s. Rule id r-8742
incident-bot: NOTE: SLO breach window started at 2353456700, currently p99=1.2s, affected requests ~0.8%
Jess (sre): after rollback + cache + replica, p95 down to 220ms, p99 down to 420ms. streaming_tail_errors -> 6
Ana (oncall): good. Keep monitoring 15m. If stable, we'll close and file postmortem. Assigning action items: Mike - verify replica sync and token-store patch; Tom - stabilize routing rule & rollback after 30m if ok; Jess - run replay eval against canary prompt set to check quality regressions; Ana - draft customer note and post-incident summary.
Mike (infra): started patch to token service to add batched token fetch path, will PR in ~2h.
Tom (prod-eng): I'll schedule a canary for 20m followed by controlled rollout if green.
Jess (sre): logging tags for postmortem: `incident=2353456789`, `root=caching+tokenstore`, `mitigation=rb+cache+replica`
Ana (oncall): handing off to day team in 30m. Handoff note: mitigations applied, p99 under SLO, monitoring in place. @day-sre you'll take incident channel for final verification.
day-sre: ack, will monitor and escalate if regression.
Ana (oncall): closing the page for now, leaving thread open for postmortem comments :thumbsup:
